content.text: MyCare is a mobile healthcare application by Mayapada Hospital that enables patients to find doctors, book appointments, and manage their hospital visits seamlessly in one integrated experience.

UX Case Highlight

Hospital appointment booking is often time-consuming, requires repetitive manual registration, and lacks clear confirmation. This creates long queues, higher administrative workload, and low digital adoption.

The challenge was to design a fast, trustworthy, and reassuring booking experience that allows patients to complete the process confidently and skip manual data entry at the hospital.

UX approach & key decisions:

  • - Simplified the end-to-end booking flow with a clear stepper and guided actions
  • - Prioritized nearest hospital selection to reduce decision time
  • - Added doctor trust signals (experience, ratings, reviews, specialization) for faster and more confident choices
  • - Grouped schedule by day with prominent time slots for quick scanning
  • - Created transparent payment summary to eliminate cost uncertainty
  • - Designed QR-based confirmation for seamless on-site check-in without re-entering patient data

Outcome:

A streamlined healthcare booking experience that reduces hospital queues, improves operational efficiency, and increases patient confidence through a clear, fast, and trust-driven mobile journey.
